gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-004 identifies the same incorrect illustrative evaluation of the complex-onset delay term: the example uses the square-root denominator instead of the governing 1−V₁ denominator, understates the contribution by a factor of two, and supplies the corresponding corrected value and repair.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The numerical example evaluates the epsilonc< delay contribution with (1/2)log(1/sqrt(1−V₁)) although the bound contains (1/2)log(1/(1−V₁)), producing approximately 1.68 instead of approximately 3.36.

component_coverage.gold_component: The illustrative complex-onset delay contribution uses the wrong logarithmic denominator and is therefore understated by a factor of two; the corrected expression and numerical assessment are required.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction explicitly contrasts the governing (1/2)log(1/(1−V₁)) term with the erroneous square-root form, computes the approximately doubled value, identifies the understated delay explanation, and gives the specific repair.
